name: School of Illusion
summary: Wizards who deceive the senses and make illusions real.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.short: Copy illusion spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a illusion spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.short: Minor Illusion makes sound and image together.
features.summary: You learn Minor Illusion (or another wizard cantrip if you know it). When you cast it, you can create both a sound and an image with a single casting.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.short: Change your lasting illusions with an action.
features.summary: When you cast an illusion spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can use your action to change its nature (within the spell's normal parameters) while you can see it.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.short: Reaction: an illusory duplicate makes an attack miss.
features.summary: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to interpose an illusory duplicate; the attack automatically misses. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.short: Make one inanimate, nonmagical object from an illusion real.
features.summary: When you cast an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose one inanimate, nonmagical object that is part of the illusion and make it real for 1 minute. It can't deal damage or directly harm anyone.
